page.overview:
What is RWQFSFASXC?

RWQFSFASXC, also known as Shadow Bonnie or RXQ for short, is the main antagonist of Hide-and-Seek, the third story of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

Like his game counterpart, Shadow Bonnie is pitch black. However, unlike his game counterpart, he doesn't closely resemble Toy Bonnie. Instead, Shadow Bonnie starts out as a black two-dimensional cutout of Bonnie the Rabbit for the Hide-and-Seek game. When Toby destroys the game, it attaches itself to Toby’s back. In this form, Shadow Bonnie appears as a dark shadow with rabbit ears. Eventually, it grows in size and two narrow eyes form on the shadow. Shadow Bonnie later forms a row of two spiked teeth.

Shadow Bonnie stars in the minigame Hide-and-Seek. at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and Games. Upon the game starting, Shadow Bonnie slides out on a rail and hides in one of fifteen locations. The player must find Shadow Bonnie in three tries within three minutes in order to win. He is released when the protagonist Toby destroys the game out of anger.

Shadow Bonnie fills two distinct roles: the sought after character in Hide-and-Seek and Toby's tormentor. When Hide-and-Seek opens at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and Games, Toby sees it as the perfect opportunity to finally beat his brother Connor at one of the location's games. Unable to win on the first day, Toby makes rail blocks in woodworking class and on the next attempt, begins blocking off parts of the game, limiting the locations the rabbit can use to hide. Despite this, Shadow Bonnie remains evasive. Angered, Toby blocks off every section so the rabbit can't hide anywhere. When the game lights next turn off, Shadow Bonnie wasn't blocked and disappeared. After checking every location and finding nothing, Toby snaps and destroys the game.
